name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-thinking-loop-guard
description: Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus a mid-stream breaker that ends a single call repeating its visible output (maxRepeatedText for identical deltas, maxRepeatedCycleChars for a cycled few-line bleed), which no post-call detector can reach. Ships an offline session analyzer that replays a session jsonl through the same detector and reports its own parse coverage, so a zero over an unreadable file cannot be mistaken for health. Compatible with every published dsh line from 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.0-rc.2 (each one run); writes its reactions under a producer-owned message source, because session format v4 refuses the retired bare `plugin` kind.
